after.name: sales_order_net
after.display_name: 订单净销售额与毛利数据
after.query_sql: SELECT o.order_no, o.store_id, o.member_id, o.channel, o.ordered_at, o.pay_amount, COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, o.pay_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_amount, COALESCE(c.cost_amount, 0) AS cost_amount, o.pay_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) - COALESCE(c.cost_amount, 0) AS gross_profit_amount FROM qinghe_mart.sales_orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_no, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM qinghe_mart.refunds WHERE status = '已退款' GROUP BY order_no) r ON r.order_no = o.order_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.order_no, SUM(i.qty * p.cost_price) AS cost_amount FROM qinghe_mart.sales_order_items i JOIN qinghe_mart.products p ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY i.order_no) c ON c.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.status = '已完成'

after.name: inventory_cost_daily
after.query_sql: SELECT d.stat_date, COALESCE(v.inv_cost, 0) AS inv_cost, COALESCE(s.sales_cost, 0) AS sales_cost, COALESCE(l.loss_cost, 0) AS loss_cost FROM (SELECT snapshot_date AS stat_date FROM qinghe_mart.inventory_daily UNION SELECT DATE(ordered_at) AS stat_date FROM qinghe_mart.sales_orders WHERE status = '已完成' UNION SELECT counted_on AS stat_date FROM qinghe_mart.stocktakes WHERE status = '已确认') d LEFT JOIN (SELECT snapshot_date AS stat_date, SUM(on_hand_cost) AS inv_cost FROM qinghe_mart.inventory_daily GROUP BY snapshot_date) v ON v.stat_date = d.stat_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(o.ordered_at) AS stat_date, SUM(i.qty * p.cost_price) AS sales_cost FROM qinghe_mart.sales_orders o JOIN qinghe_mart.sales_order_items i ON i.order_no = o.order_no JOIN qinghe_mart.products p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY DATE(o.ordered_at)) s ON s.stat_date = d.stat_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.counted_on AS stat_date, SUM((i.book_qty - i.counted_qty) * p.cost_price) AS loss_cost FROM qinghe_mart.stocktakes t JOIN qinghe_mart.stocktake_items i ON i.stocktake_no = t.stocktake_no JOIN qinghe_mart.products p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE t.status = '已确认' AND i.counted_qty < i.book_qty GROUP BY t.counted_on) l ON l.stat_date = d.stat_date

columns.name: inv_cost
columns.comment: 当日日末库存成本合计

columns.name: sales_cost
columns.comment: 当日销售成本（数量×进价）

after.description: 按日合并库存快照成本、销售成本与盘亏成本，供库存周转天数与盘亏损耗率使用
